headline: Last session: Sensex surges nearly 900 points as Nifty reclaims 22,500 led by IT stock rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 13 October.

why: Sharp recovery in IT stocks, led by gains in TCS, lifted market sentiment in the last trading session.
Broad-based buying was witnessed as all sectoral indices turned green on Friday.
IT sector jumped around 3% while FMCG stocks gained over 2% during the previous trade.
Markets bounced back strongly after previous sharp losses where Sensex had fallen over 1,000 points.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Sensex climbed nearly 900 points while Nifty settled above 22,500.
An IndiGo Delhi-Chennai flight was diverted and landed safely in Hyderabad due to a power bank smoke alert.
India's nuclear energy sector is projected to attract ₹7.5 lakh crore in private investment by 2047.
Stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading in the next session.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian markets rebounded sharply with the Sensex jumping nearly 900 points and Nifty closing above 22,500. The rally was spearheaded by IT stocks such as TCS alongside gains in FMCG and other sectors. Markets remain closed today for the weekend.
